title: Usage Insights page layout + filters (breakdown view) — responsive + edge cases
creator: Tessa Morgan
description:
## Summary
Design the Usage → Cost / Usage Insights breakdown page layout and filter interactions for the Route × Model breakdown (and drilldowns). Includes responsive behavior, empty/partial states, and edge cases.

This ticket focuses on the *page shell + filters + table layout* (not top driver visualization details — see DES-913; not export messaging — see DES-914).

## References / links
- Confluence UX spec (draft): `sources/confluence/product-docs/design-specs/usage-insights-console-ux-spec.json`
- PRD: `sources/confluence/product-docs/requirements/in-console-usage-insights-prd.json`
- Data freshness indicator requirements: ENG-3824

Figma:
- File: "Usage Insights — Breakdown" (Console / Analytics)
- Prototype: (internal) figma://redwood/console/usage-insights/breakdown-v2

## Primary user goal
"I need to quickly see what routes + models are driving spend, then filter/drill down and export. The totals should reconcile with billing and the UI should tell me when data is partial or lagging."

## Information architecture
Left nav:
- Usage
  - Overview (existing)
  - **Usage Insights (Beta)** (new)

Usage Insights landing uses tabs:
- **Breakdown** (this ticket)
- Top cost drivers (DES-913)

Breakdown page contains:
1) Page header (title + beta pill + help link)
2) Global filter bar (time range + workspace/project + env + optional dims)
3) Breakdown table module
4) Drilldown panel / navigation (route → models; model → routes)

## Filter bar — interaction spec
### Filters (v1)
Required filters:
- Time range (default: Last 7 days)
- Project (default: All projects)
Optional filters (appear if data exists / enabled):
- Environment (Prod / Staging / Dev — names are workspace-defined)
- Deployment mode (Hosted / Dedicated / Private)
- Region
- Route (searchable; selected values are normalized route templates)
- Model (searchable; includes family + version bucket)

Notes:
- We should avoid showing too many filters by default. Proposed approach:
  - Always show: Time range, Project
  - Show as "More filters" dropdown: Environment, Deployment mode, Region, Route, Model
  - Once a user selects any "More" filter, it appears as a persistent chip in the bar for quick editing.

### Filter UI components
- Time range: segmented control + custom range
  - Presets: 24h, 7d, 30d
  - Custom range: date picker; timezone label (workspace setting) shown under picker
- Project: single-select dropdown (searchable) with "All projects"
- More filters: dropdown with sections + search
- Selected filters: chips with inline remove (x)
- Clear all: visible when any non-default filter is active

### Query/apply behavior
- Default behavior: apply filters immediately on change (no "Apply" button) *except* custom date range, which uses "Apply" in the date picker popover.
- Loading behavior:
  - Preserve previous table rows with a loading overlay (avoid full empty flicker)
  - If response > 2s, show inline skeleton rows and keep column widths stable

### URL / shareability
- Filter state is encoded in the URL query string so users can copy/paste within the org (RBAC still enforced).
- Example:
  - `.../usage/insights/breakdown?range=7d&project=all&env=prod&route=/v1/chat/completions&model=llama-3.1-70b`

## Breakdown table layout
### Default grouping
Default view (no Route/Model filter applied):
- Table grouped by **Route**, with top models nested on expand.
- Alternative pivot via toggle: "Group by: Route | Model" (toggle control above table)

Rationale:
- Matches common mental model of endpoints/features as cost centers.

### Columns (v1)
Pinned left:
- Route (or Model, depending on grouping)

Core metrics:
- Total cost (USD)
- Requests
- Input tokens
- Output tokens
- Cache hit rate
- p95 latency

Behavior:
- Sort defaults to Total cost desc.
- Column picker: NOT in beta (avoid complexity). Columns are fixed for v1.

### Expand / drilldown
- Each row has chevron to expand to show the other dimension:
  - Group by Route → expand shows top Models under that route
  - Group by Model → expand shows top Routes using that model
- Expanded rows use indentation + lighter background.
- Row click navigates to a drilldown page (or in-page panel) showing time series + breakdown details (ENG implementation TBD; we designed for navigation-first to reduce complexity).

### Truncation and long strings
- Route and model names truncate with ellipsis.
- On hover, show a tooltip with full value + "Copy" affordance.
- For routes, show a "Normalized" info icon that explains templating (e.g., `/v1/files/:file_id`). Tooltip copy provided below.

## Responsive behavior
### Desktop (≥ 1200px)
- Filter bar is single row with chips.
- Table shows all columns.

### Tablet (768–1199px)
- Filter bar wraps to two lines.
- Table uses horizontal scroll for metric columns (Route/Model column remains sticky).

### Mobile (< 768px)
- Filter bar becomes a single "Filters" button opening a bottom sheet.
- Table switches to stacked rows (card-like):
  - Primary label (Route/Model)
  - Total cost prominent
  - Secondary metrics in two-column grid
- Expand/drilldown is via "View details" rather than chevron.

## Edge cases / states
### 1) No data
Conditions:
- New workspace with no usage in selected range
- Filter combination yields zero rows

UI:
- Empty state with:
  - Message: "No usage found for this time range"
  - CTA: "Reset filters" + link to docs "How Usage Insights works"

### 2) Partial / lagging data
- Banner at top of module when `freshness_lag_minutes` exceeds threshold.
- Banner copy (draft):
  - Title: "Usage data is still updating"
  - Body: "Data may be incomplete for the last ~X minutes. Totals can change as late events arrive."
  - Link: "Learn more" → help center article

### 3) Permissions: user can’t view cost
- If workspace setting hides cost or role lacks permission, the page is still visible but cost fields are obfuscated.
- Behavior:
  - Total cost column replaced with "—"
  - Banner: "You don’t have permission to view cost. Ask a workspace admin."
  - Usage metrics (requests/tokens/latency) remain visible (confirm with PM; this is the recommended design)

### 4) Cardinality guardrails
- If too many unique routes/models exist for a range, backend may cap results.
- UI behavior:
  - Inline note under table: "Showing top 500 rows by cost. Refine filters to see more." (number to be driven by API)

### 5) Very long custom route prefixes / OpenAI-compatible paths
- Ensure layout supports `/openai/v1/chat/completions` and customer proxy prefixes.
- Tooltip includes full path; copy icon helps support workflows.

## Tooltip / microcopy (final)
- Route normalization info tooltip:
  - "Routes are normalized to group dynamic path segments (e.g., IDs) so you can compare usage over time."
- Cache hit rate tooltip:
  - "Percent of tokens served from cache for requests in this row. Cache behavior varies by model and configuration."

## Accessibility notes
- All filters reachable by keyboard; focus states visible.
- Chips announce removal action.
- Table rows and expand controls have ARIA labels ("Expand route /v1/chat/completions").
- Color usage in banners meets contrast.

## Acceptance criteria
- Figma frames for desktop/tablet/mobile for:
  - Default breakdown view (group by Route)
  - Group-by toggle state (group by Model)
  - Empty state
  - Partial data banner state
  - No-cost-permission state
  - Expanded row state
- Clickable prototype demonstrates:
  - Opening filters, selecting route/model, clearing filters
  - Row expand vs row click (drilldown)
- Spec notes include copy, truncation rules, and responsive behavior.

## Handoff notes (for ENG-3815)
- Sticky first column required for desktop/tablet.
- Horizontal scroll acceptable on tablet; keep first column fixed.
- Mobile stacked rows can reuse existing Console "metric card" pattern.

## Decisions / notes from reviews
- 2026-01-28 Design review (Tessa, Alicia, Dylan, Nora): prefer "More filters" to reduce initial clutter; chips appear only when used.
- 2026-02-03 PM review (Marissa, Paula): default grouping = Route; add group-by toggle to support finance model-centric reporting.
- 2026-02-10 DevEx feedback (Alex): avoid ambiguous term "Endpoint"; use "Route" in UI but add tooltip to explain normalization.

## Open questions
- Confirm whether users without cost permission should still see tokens/requests/latency (proposed yes). Owner: Marissa.
- Confirm max rows cap copy + value (needs API field). Owner: Chloe.

## Final deliverables
- Figma file updated + prototype linked above.
- Spec notes copied into Confluence UX spec draft for consolidation.
